verdict.rationale: Fivetran offers official SDKs (Connector SDK for Python, REST API, MCP server) that AI-native users can build against, and even provides AI coding agent plugins for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and Copilot CLI to build connectors via natural language. However, there's no evidence of broader multi-language SDKs or a general-purpose developer SDK ecosystem beyond the connector/REST API scope, and OpenAPI/spec discoverability probes failed. missing for 10: multi-language SDK support, publicly discoverable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on developer validation of SDK quality beyond the connector use case.
